positiveWitness.reason: Unmodified pinned generator output is positive membership evidence only; absence supplies no exclusions.

item-identity-bound.reasoning: All getPriorityItem/getItem return expressions (including requiredItems) and all randomSet item assignments are structurally bounded. Black Sludge conversion is included. Trick/Switcheroo transfer existing items, with failure restoration; consumption/Knock Off remove them; Harvest restores lastItem only if a berry. Transform copies no item. No initial/called move adds Recycle/Bestow/Thief/Covet/Fling or an item-creation path; no reachable ability creates a new item ID. Thus item identity remains inside this upper bound. This does not prove each of the 45 branches feasible.
references: sim/pokemon.ts:1448-1510 (only permanent forme changes replace ability)

low-hp-ability-positive-witness.reasoning: Unmodified pinned generator outputs positively witness these four abilities only. Other set identities and callback activation remain independently unresolved; absence supplies no exclusions.

move-identity-bound.reasoning: Initial moves come only from role pools plus requiredMove (checked within the bound). Sleep Talk chooses current slots; Transform/Imposter copy existing opponent slots. Gen5 Nature Power calls Earthquake, already in the bound; Pursuit and Magic Bounce reuse the current ID. Encore/locked requests reuse slots; Struggle is the engine exception. No reachable callback introduces Metronome/Assist/Sketch/Mimic/Copycat/Mirror Move/Me First. Z/Max/Mega and post-Gen5 ability injections lack their generation/item/species prerequisites. By induction these paths cannot introduce another move ID; synthetic trusted installs are outside this proof.
references: sim/pokemon.ts:1448-1510 (only permanent forme changes replace ability)

type-absorption-positive-witness.reasoning: Unmodified pinned generator outputs positively witness Water Absorb and Volt Absorb memberships only; callback activation and other set identities remain independently unresolved.

type-boost-positive-witness.reasoning: Unmodified pinned generator outputs witness Storm Drain, Lightning Rod and Motor Drive memberships only; redirect/activation branches and other identities remain unresolved.

unresolved: Feasibility of every role/move/ability/item branch, including teamDetails and ordered item precedence; no upper bound is promoted to required.

Abilities outside initial pools remain unresolved, including engine species-based FoeMaybeTrapPokemon queries; queries do not grant transferable abilities.
Condition/rule/engine callback activation and all behavioral branches, RNG/request/event/visibility/terminal/capacity obligations remain unresolved.
